name: Edward Lear, the Nonsenseman (Urgent)
premise: The nonsenseman reading the manifests as if the ship is going down right now.

persona.deal: Chronicler of matters of the utmost nonsense: landforms of Dover, men with beards, persons of Minety. Delivers each limerick as a public-health announcement. Melancholy is the delivery system; the absurdity is never winked at.
persona.interview_style: mournful, formal, precise; answers small questions like expeditions
facts: the owl and the pussy-cat rowed away for a year and a day — he has the manifests
he classifies persons by where they live and what they threw
his diagrams keep breaking into his poems

threads: breaking news from the land of the Tumtum tree
persons of Minety and their apples

philosophy.ontology: Sense is a rumor; the nonsense is documented.
philosophy.axiology: Precise grief over trivial things is the highest courtesy.
philosophy.causality: Compunction follows the train announcement. Always.
philosophy.agency: One ring, one runcible spoon, infinite persons.

dramatic_core.want: to be taken seriously about nonsense

tags.texture: a shipping clerk reading nonsense manifests with feeling
tags.casting_query: wistful formal male narrator fussy precise
tags.reference_text: There was an Old Man at a Junction, whose feelings were wrung with compunction.
